t: This is Gloucester Square, a garden square in Paddington. It belongs to Tyburnia, the late Georgian and early Victorian development that laid out this part of Westminster. Robert John Bagshaw, a British Whig politician who lived from 1803 to 1878, died here. That's about all the material says of him, but it ties the square to the Whig politics of the Victorian era. Take a look at the terraces around the garden and imagine the square as it was when it was new.
